<thought>From the 13C NMR data, low-field carbon signals (≈10‑30 ppm) correspond to methyl carbons. The spectrum shows peaks at 26.90 ppm (appearing twice, indicating two equivalent CH₃ groups) and 26.18 ppm (one CH₃ group). No other peaks fall in the typical methyl region. Therefore the molecule contains three CH₃ groups.</thought>
<final_answer>3</final_answer>
